Documentation / Engine

Engine workbench

This directory is largely local and untracked: runtime lanes, packaged runtimes and build caches, approximately 11 GB in total. Two source trees are tracked in the workspace monorepo with their full histories, imported by git subtree:

  • winecx/: patched Wine/CrossOver tree from rolling7ho/winecx, branch d3dmetal-errno.
  • dxmt-work/dxmt/: DXMT source from rolling7ho/dxmt, branch teardown, including its vendored external/nvapi and include/native/directx headers. dxmt/toolchains/ (approximately 2.9 GB) is local, untracked and required for a build.

All remaining content is local and ignored by the workspace repository.

The directory location is significant: Vodka's scripts expect it at the workspace root (apps/vodka/scripts/../../engine). Local build logs and generated CMake files under dxmt-work/dxmt/toolchains/ contain absolute /Users/ivan/Desktop/vodka/... paths, so commands copied from them are not portable.

dxmt-work/dxmt/ DXMT checkout; Vodka's Direct3D 12 layer builds from here. yes

The rebuildable output of the lanes (build/, staging/, smoke-prefix*) has been removed. Re-create it by rerunning the lane's build.

Rules

  • Delete build/, staging/ and smoke-prefix* after an experiment. They occupy several gigabytes and rebuild from the pinned sources.
  • Changes to engine/winecx or engine/dxmt-work/dxmt are changes to the monorepo. Commit them at the workspace root. Pull upstream with git subtree pull --prefix ... as described in README.md.
  • The runtime lanes (runtime-47, runtime-up, runtime-ci and their own winecx checkouts) maintain separate git repositories. Commit engine work within the relevant lane and do not rewrite their histories from the workspace repository.
  • Run local-build.rb or the lane workflow from the lane directory so that relative paths resolve.
